thread:
olivia_sales: Quick ask — AcmeCorp (legal: kate@acme.com) is asking for our SOC 2 Type II report to proceed with a dedicated POC. They also want a bridge/acknowledgement or presigned evidence link before signing full contract. They want something by EOD tomorrow. Who can help? cc @ryan_security @maria_legal
ryan_security: We can't hand out the full SOC 2 report publicly without an executed NDA. Options: 1) SOC2 Acknowledgement letter (short, safe to share) 2) Redacted SOC2 extract or CAIQ excerpt via time-limited presigned link after NDA 3) Bridge letter (compliance confirmation) — fastest is ack/bridge.
maria_legal: +1. For full report or SSP extracts we require an executed NDA. We have a short-form NDA we can DocuSign same day. If they refuse NDA we can still provide the acknowledgement/bridge letter and a limited CAIQ summary.
jake_ae: FYI — Acme's vendor team is asking for certain SIG rows and some control evidence. Will ack + CAIQ excerpt satisfy them? Or do they need real artifacts (screenshots, logs)?
ryan_security: For SIG/CAIQ we can provide a redacted CAIQ and answers to specific SIG rows. Artifacts (screenshots/logs) are considered evidence and need NDA/presigned access. Redaction rules: remove employee names, internal hostnames/IPs, ticket IDs, PII. Do NOT remove or edit auditor statements.
olivia_sales: If we tell them NDA now, what's the ETA to get a presigned link + ack letter posted?
maria_legal: If NDA is signed and returned this morning I can approve ack letter + scope within ~6 business hours. Presigned link to requested artifacts: 24 hours (depends on redaction load). Full redaction of an entire SOC2 report: 24-48 hours.
sam_enginfra: I can generate presigned S3 objects once legal posts the approved scope. Example command we use for a 72h link: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/soc2-extracts/acme-2026-03.pdf --expires-in 259200` — we can add IP restriction if Acme provides CIDR.
olivia_sales: Helpful. Can legal drop a short ack letter template I can forward to Acme now? Also will we accept their NDA or prefer our template?
maria_legal: We prefer our short-form NDA for speed but will review theirs if it's minimal. Ack template — paste below (feel free to forward):

Subject: Redwood Inference — SOC 2 Acknowledgement

To whom it may concern,

Redwood Inference confirms that we maintain a SOC 2 Type II report covering the period mm/dd/yyyy — mm/dd/yyyy, audited by [auditor name]. The report addresses the Security Trust Services Criteria. This acknowledgement is provided for vendor risk review purposes and does not constitute delivery of the full report. Detailed artifacts and the report itself will be provided to recipients under a signed NDA or as a time-limited presigned link per our evidence sharing process.

If you require specific SIG/CAIQ items, please list them and we will respond with redacted excerpts or presigned evidence per the agreed scope.

Regards,
Redwood Inference Compliance Team

maria_legal: (note) we must include standard conf/limiters above before sending.
compliance-bot: Reminder — create a #security-evidence ticket before issuing presigned links (policy: include scope, recipient email(s), expiry).
olivia_sales: Action plan: 1) I'll send our NDA template to kate@acme.com now 2) Ask Acme to list any SIG rows they require and provide an IP/CIDR if they want IP-restricted presigned links 3) Once NDA is signed, @maria_legal will approve scope and @sam_enginfra will generate presigned link. I'll update thread when Acme responds. :rocket:
